name: Redshift Wedge
desc: A galaxy redshift survey plotted as the classic bowtie wedge — the observer at the apex, right ascension fanning across and redshift running outward, thousands of galaxies drifting away in the Hubble flow and reddening as they go, clumped into great walls and radial fingers-of-god around vast empty voids.
